summary: A security patch. Four open Dependabot alerts are closed by bumping transitive dependencies to their patched releases: `dnspython`, `opentelemetry-api` and `soupsieve` in `uv.lock`, and `minimatch` in `pnpm-lock.yaml`. No MCP tool, CLI command, prompt, resource or documentation URL changes.

sections.title: 🛡️ Security
items: `dnspython` 2.9.0 → 2.9.2 (CVE-2026-128089, GHSA-vvf4-9x63-8xvv, **high**): an unchecked WKS service number let a crafted zone file exhaust memory and CPU. Reached through `fastmcp` → `pydantic[email]` → `email-validator`.

`opentelemetry-api` 1.45.1 → 1.45.2 (CVE-2026-126360, GHSA-mf5v-w3w3-f6cg, medium): quadratic regex backtracking in `TraceContextTextMapPropagator.extract()` when a carrier preserves embedded newlines. Reached through `mcp` and `fastmcp-slim`.

`soupsieve` 3.0.4 → 4.1.3 (CVE-2026-126190, GHSA-mmhr-3c5m-f64f, **high**): descendant-combinator selectors matched in polynomial time on deeply nested documents. Reached only through the docs site's `furo` → `beautifulsoup4` chain, so it never shipped in the wheel.

`minimatch` 10.2.6 → 11.x (CVE-2026-118764, GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249, medium): reached only through `eslint`, which pnpm auto-installed at 10.13.0 to satisfy `eslint-plugin-turbo`'s peer range. `eslint` is now an explicit devDependency at `^10.15.0` — the first release whose own `minimatch` range is `^11.0.5` — so no `overrides` entry was needed.

sections.title: 📝 Notes
sections.items: No source file under `apps/server/src` changes, so the published wheel differs from 0.7.1 only in its version string and in the `dnspython` / `opentelemetry-api` pins the lock records. `soupsieve` and `minimatch` are development-only (docs site and Node toolchain respectively). The docs site was rebuilt against `soupsieve` 4.1.3 to confirm the major jump is compatible; `poe check` (511 tests) and `pnpm check` both pass.

upgrade_notes: No breaking changes to the shipped API, CLI, MCP tools or documentation URLs. Upgrading is a routine version bump; if you vendor `uv.lock`, the only deltas are the two runtime pins and the project version.
